column1: # The verdict per owner: what became of the application behind the data.
# The orphan set is the acceptance list of the plan's Part B section 7, and it
# is asserted exactly: an owner that appears here and should not, or one that
# is missing, is a regression in the resolution order rather than a tuning
# question. "corroborating" is what the report prints as "possible": the only
# Verdicts are computed against a fixed clock a year past the fixture's
# creation, so nothing is protected by the thirty-day recency keep signal.
# That signal has its own test in verdict_test.go.
